title: Relief band at the Empire Ballroom
summary: His college and kids' bands relief Benny Carter at the Empire Ballroom.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Around that time I guess you were with Charlie Barnett; right?

I was getting into that and that's where I met Red Norvo. But before that--remember we were talking about Cozy Cole, with the kids band I was in; at the same time I was in Columbia Blue Lions, ran them both--I didn't run Columbia but the other one I was involved in. We got a job at the--this was the Empire Ballroom, and Benny Carter and the other band--we were the relief band--
